Hi Alicia — great to hear, and happy to run the POC with you. Short answers up front:

- Yes — we support rebadged/skin deployments where partners present Redwood-powered features as their own (we call it a rebadge/skinning POC).
- Typical pre-reqs: MSA + SOW, basic SOC2 attestation, network/egress checklist for private deploys (only for customers choosing private Dedicated/Private).
- Telemetry: we can minimize telemetry surfaced to partners; there are two categories — operational telemetry (required for SLA/health) and product analytics (optional).

Putting Karthik and Marissa on this thread to scope tech and commercial. Karthik — can you outline a 6-week SOW skeleton (tech milestones + acceptance criteria) and flag any blockers for a rebadged SDK flow? Marissa — can you draft rough POC pricing and a production uplift estimate so Alicia has numbers to take to procurement?

Subject: Re: Rebadged integration POC — tech SOW draft

Hi all — draft tech scope below (high level). I'll prepare a doc with runbooks and required test datasets by EOD 10/21.

POC scope (6 weeks):
- Week 0: Kickoff, environment access, account setup, and test data onboarding (sanitized dataset).
- Week 1–2: Integration of the rebadged SDK into MerchantFlow web client. Skinning includes: custom header/footer message template, brand colors, and a prefix token indicating brand name. No model-level parameter changes.
- Week 3: Latency/load testing (client flows up to 50 concurrent users). Measure p95 and p99, quantify cost per 1K tokens.
- Week 4: Functional evals on search and order-assist prompts; build pass/fail prompt set.
- Week 5: Feedback iteration and flagging of any hallucination/quality regressions.
- Week 6: Acceptance and runbook handoff; production uplift plan.

Technical constraints and notes:
- Data residency: for hosted POC we do not persist customer message content beyond 30 days by default; we can agree on a shorter retention for the POC.
- Telemetry: operational telemetry will include anonymized request IDs and aggregated latency; payload-level logging is opt-in and requires agreement.
- Branding: the SDK includes a client-side CSS/HTML layer that MerchantFlow can fully control; the server runtime will include a small response footer string that indicates the underlying runtime for transparency (this can be suppressed with a contractual clause).
- Auth: we recommend a scoped API key per MerchantFlow environment; for Dedicated/Private we can support mutual TLS.

Acceptance criteria (example):
- Seeded prompt set pass rate >= 92% (TBD with MerchantFlow).
- p95 latency <= 250ms for single-turn prompts at 512 tokens.
- No unresolved security findings from our standard checklist.

I'll attach the tech appendix with exact API endpoints and the sample client wrapper.

— Karthik
Principal Engineer, Integrations

[Attachment: technical_appendix_rebadge.pdf (PDF)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Rebadged integration POC — MSA and licensing notes

Hi Alicia / MerchantFlow legal team — copying key tech on the thread. Quick points from our side regarding the MSA and rebadge licensing:

- We are open to a rebadge clause that permits MerchantFlow to present features as "MerchantFlow AI" provided there is a clear attribution clause in the MSA and explicit acceptance of our SLA and usage policies.
- POC pricing is typically a capped fixed price + token-usage reconciliation if we exceed forecasted volumes. We'll propose exact numbers after Marissa provides the commercial ask.
- Telemetry & data: Redwood will not use PII for model training without written consent. Operational telemetry necessary for health/SLAs is retained for 30 days during the POC; retention can be shortened on request.
- IP: the runtime and models remain Redwood IP; the SOW will grant a limited license to MerchantFlow for redistribution of the client SDK and UI skinning assets only.
- Indemnity/limitation: we prefer mutual limited liability and carve-outs for third-party integrations; if MerchantFlow needs stronger indemnities for regulated customers we can discuss an uplift.

We have attached our MSA template and a short SOW sample. If MerchantFlow legal can provide redlines we'll review them and propose a tracked version.

Thanks — Vivek Kulkarni
VP Legal & Compliance

[Attachment: MerchantFlow_MSA_v1.pdf (PDF)]
